compatible_contracts.compatibility_policy: Gate 0 is additive. Existing synthetic runtime columns and state values remain valid; no destructive migration is authorized.

identifiers.synthetic_subject_rule: All repository fixtures use SYN- display codes and synthetic_only=true.

properties.value_or_unknown: either a typed value or one explicit enums.unknown_state; blank is not equivalent to normal
properties.author_subject_id: server-resolved subject; AI author must never be represented as doctor
properties.source_anchor_ids: array of SourceAnchor.id; empty only when explicitly marked source_pending
properties.confidence: nullable number from 0 through 1 for derived content only
properties.integrity_hash: sha256 of canonical content and immutable metadata

rules: A field value is append-only after signed status.
AI output uses record_kind=ai_draft and source_role=ai.
doctor_judgment requires source_role=doctor and a server-resolved verified doctor subject.
Unknown, not collected, not applicable and declined are first-class values.
AI must not infer a normal value from absence.

Vault.purpose: Logical personal control domain. Gate 0 defines references and policy boundaries; it does not claim production cryptographic isolation is implemented.

properties.synthetic_only: must be true in repository and current runtime
properties.key_reference: nullable production KMS reference; never raw key material

invariants: A patient vault owns original patient facts and media references.
A doctor vault owns private methods, templates and notes, but not an unbounded copy of a patient vault.
Vault identifiers do not grant access; authorization is evaluated for every object.
Doctor invitation does not activate the relationship.
Patient acceptance is required.
Relationships are independent for each doctor-patient pair.

properties.recipient_subject_id: doctor or explicitly approved care executor
properties.purpose: exact purpose used in authorization decision
properties.resource_object_ids: optional object-level allow-list; empty means category scope only

invariants: Consent is not inferred from invitation, account creation or relationship request.
Scope expansion creates a new grant version and requires patient action.
Revocation denies new access immediately and is preserved as an event.

properties.patient_subject_id: security subject; maps to legacy patients record during compatibility period
properties.doctor_subject_id: nullable until doctor action; required by doctor_reviewed
properties.consent_grant_id: active ConsentGrant.id for encounter creation purpose

invariants: Signed versions are immutable.
Correction creates a new version that references the signed version.
Withdrawal changes validity through an event and does not delete history.
AI cannot review or sign.

properties.source_type: text, audio, video, image, document, structured_form or external_reference
properties.storage_reference: nullable opaque storage reference; never a public URL

properties.anchor: type-specific JSON: char range, time range, page+bbox or object version

invariants: An anchor always refers to an immutable source version.
A derived value cannot silently move its anchor to a newer source version.

properties.task_type: transcription, extraction, clinical_record_draft, gap_check or follow_up_comparison
properties.draft_payload: must not be written to doctor judgment tables
properties.status: generated, doctor_review_pending, accepted_in_part, rejected or superseded

invariants: AI draft is stored separately from patient fact, doctor observation and doctor judgment.
AI draft cannot transition to signed.
Accepting content creates a new human-authored field value and retains a review decision.

properties.json_pointer: field path inside immutable AI output

properties.manifest: minimum source object versions and field values relied on by the doctor
properties.doctor_vault_reference: nullable reference to minimum responsibility copy, never full patient vault

properties.actor_subject_id: server-resolved subject or system service identity
properties.metadata: no secret, token, credential or unnecessary clinical content

invariants: Every persistent write produces an audit event in the same unit of work or a transactionally coupled outbox.
Allowed and denied sensitive reads are audited.
Audit events are not deleted when consent is revoked or a record is withdrawn.

clinical_record.signed_correction_rule: Create a new draft version linked by supersedes_record_version_id; never mutate the signed version.

encounter_create: active consent covers purpose and requested field categories
synthetic subject and data in Gate 0
clinical_record_sign: active consent covers purpose and signed fields

global_invariants: Only synthetic data is allowed in the repository, tests and current runtime.
Patient original facts belong to the patient private vault; doctor private knowledge belongs to the doctor private vault.
A care relationship and consent grant authorize references, not ownership transfer or full vault copying.
Patient fact, doctor observation, doctor judgment, external evidence and AI draft remain distinct record kinds.
AI cannot consent, accept a relationship, sign, withdraw a doctor record or promote its own draft.
Signed versions and their source manifest are immutable; correction and withdrawal are additive.
Every field displayed as sourced can resolve to an immutable source object version and anchor.
Every persistent write and sensitive authorization decision is audited without secrets or unnecessary clinical text.
No production identity, KMS or real clinical data readiness is claimed by this contract.
remaining_gates: doctor review of TCM-CLIN-001 field dictionary
production identity provider and credential verification
secure cookie, CSRF and server-session integration for clinical APIs
production vault encryption, KMS, backup and recovery design approval
clinical HTTP writes authorized from server session rather than actor_role
retention and responsibility snapshot legal/privacy decision
end-to-end negative authorization and immutable signing tests
